summary: Iteration 24 frontend-only validation of UX phase 9 (Onboarding + Auth gate + Paywall polish) at 390x800 viewport. All acceptance criteria PASS. (1) Fresh onboarding bartender flow: 6 steps with onboarding-back-btn, onboarding-step-indicator ('Paso X de 6'), onboarding-progress role=progressbar aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax correctly updating 1..6, role=radiogroup per step, options with role=radio aria-checked, Continue disabled until selection, final step uses onboarding-finish-btn. Step 1 language selection switched UI to Spanish immediately (indicator text 'Paso 2 de 6' from step 2 onwards). (2) Completion screen onboarding-complete shown with onboarding-recommendations list (1 free rec: onboarding-rec-taking-a-drinks-order filtered to free-for-role for bartender). onboarding-start-learning-btn ('Empezar a aprender') navigates to /home. (3) Profile persistence verified via GET /api/guests/<id>: professional_profile fields all set (role=bartender, venue_type=pub, target_country=ireland, goal=first_hospitality_job, employment_status=looking_for_job) + interface_language=es + onboarding_completed=true. (4) Reload /onboarding after completion redirects to /home (finishingRef guard works). (5) Country step copy = '¿Dónde quieres trabajar?' (es) / 'Where do you want to work?' (en). (6) Learn page lists 25 situations for bartender/pub (regardless of venue). (7) AccountGate: tapping a locked situation on /learn opens premium-account-gate; title/body are Spanish paywall/auth copy; premium-gate-google slot present, premium-gate-apple present, premium-gate-notnow present, premium-gate-close present; Escape key closes gate; close button closes gate; situation remains locked. No Firebase/UID/anonymous/token technical text exposed. (8) /account guest section: account-guest, account-google-gis, account-apple-btn present; Apple click reveals account-apple-consent + account-apple-confirm-btn + account-apple-cancel-btn. (9) No horizontal overflow at 390px on onboarding, /learn, /learn+gate, /account. (10) i18n: switching to de loads translations with no raw keys exposed on /account. (11) Regression smoke: /home /learn /practice /progress /more /listening-practice /speaking-practice all load without error boundaries. (12) No hardcoded prices anywhere in frontend/src (grep -E '€|5\.99|39\.99' returns 0 matches). (13) window.__BILLING__ snapshot: status=ready, isPremiumHospitality=false, offerings=[] in test env. Note: paywall component itself (premium-paywall) cannot be exercised headlessly because it only shows post-auth; code review confirms PremiumGate.js Paywall uses billing.currentOffering('hospitality') prices via priceOf(pkg).formattedPrice (paywall-plan-*-price), paywall-free-note, radiogroup with paywall-plan-annual/paywall-plan-monthly role=radio aria-checked, paywall-continue shows Processing… + disabled during purchase (aria-busy), UserCancelled (errorCode 1) returns silently to idle, success renders paywall-success + paywall-success-continue running onUnlocked=runResume. Benefits (4) are subscription.benefitSituations/Listening/Speaking/Review — no certificate text, no 'future content' claim. Overlay closes on Escape and backdrop click.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding draft persistence (localStorage DRAFT_KEY) correctly guarded by !finishingRef.current so partial state isn't re-saved during redirect to /home.
showRecommendations falls back to /home on empty/error, matching spec 'never blocks reaching /home'.

PremiumGate.requestPremium correctly short-circuits when billing.status is loading/uninitialized/error with a toast — prevents opening paywall without pricing. Note: this means during a RC outage the Home premium CTA will toast 'Premium is temporarily unavailable' rather than opening the gate, which matches spec intent.
AccountGate Escape handler is wired via Overlay effect; close button hidden when busy to prevent interrupting in-flight auth — good UX.
Paywall: cancellation errorCode===1 silently returns to idle (no toast, no error), spec-compliant.
No hardcoded prices in /app/frontend/src (grep clean). paywall-plan-*-price falls back to '—' + paywall.priceUnavailable when pkg missing.

Minor: on first Continue click of step 1, cont_disabled was null (falsy) because current language is pre-selected from app language — this is expected and matches spec 'disabled until a selection' since a selection effectively already exists. However, on step 2+ Continue is correctly disabled before selection (confirmed empirically).
Possible edge case: if user changes language on step 1 but then abandons onboarding, setLanguage() has already persisted the choice globally — acceptable per spec ('UI in Spanish immediately').

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testable scenarios pass; Paywall component itself code-only verified per spec)

seed_data_creation: One guest profile created and completed onboarding during the test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise the Paywall component UI headlessly in future runs you would need to mock Firebase auth state to appear 'authenticated' AND mock RevenueCat getOfferings to return populated annual/monthly packages with .webBillingProduct.price.formattedPrice; alternatively test by setting billing.currentOffering return via a dev shim. The AccountGate flow is fully testable without any auth. Current RC test env returns offerings:[] so even an authenticated user would see unavailable prices on the paywall. iph_language is NOT stored in a top-level localStorage key named 'iph_language' — it is persisted via guest API (confirmed: interface_language=es on GET /api/guests/<id>) and the AppContext loads it from guest. Do not assert on localStorage.iph_language.
